observations.body: Death releases the binding claim of law. Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives? But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

payload.tension: The passage states death releases the binding claim of law. Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives? But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
